title: graph : reorder get_rows for embeddings
body: ## Overview cont #29622 fix #30033 With mixed batch support, we have 3 possible graph branches that produce the input embeddings: - from tokens referencing the token embeddings weight tensor - raw embeddings - mixed: both tokens + raw The way we currently implement it leads to interleaving graph ops (such as PAD, MUL, SCALE) with the token embeddings extraction (GET_ROWS). This is not desired because it creates unnecessary splits or leads to running some of the ops on the CPU. To fix that, we have to rework the logic such that it orders all GET_ROWS to be the first nodes in the graph. We can achieve this with the `ggml_build_forward_order`. The goal is SPLIT 0 to always contain just the GET_ROWS ops and nothing else: Before: After: TODO: - [x] Refactor to make the implementation cleaner - [x] Fix Gemma4 PLE - [x] Fix a reshaped CPU tensor reaching the Meta backend (same as https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29535#issuecomment-6017306253) ## Requirements - I have read and agree with the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) - AI usage disclosure: NO
